name: Tomato
intro: Yellow star-shaped flowers develop into fruits. Ripe fruits vary in size, shape and colour.
observe: Watch flowers become green fruit, then ripe fruit. Stems and divided leaves bear hairs.
habitat: Needs plenty of sunlight and moist, well-drained soil. Growth habit varies among cultivars.
fact: Botanically, a tomato is a berry. Calling it a vegetable in cooking uses a different classification.
